items.text: "Your parcel is held. Pay £1.45 here: delivery-fee-uk.co"
items.why: Couriers don't text you links to pay small fees. Forward scam texts to 7726.

items.text: Your bank's app shows a payment you recognise
"HMRC: you're owed a £326 tax refund, claim within 24 hours"
items.why: HMRC never texts or emails about refunds with links.

items.text: A GP appointment reminder with no link and no request
"Mum, I've broken my phone, this is my new number, can you send money?"
items.why: The 'Hi Mum' scam. Call their old number to check.

items.text: An email from a shop you ordered from, with your order number
"Your account is locked. Confirm your password at this link"
A text from your bank saying 'we'll never ask for your PIN'
"You've won a prize! Just pay the delivery"
"Your TV licence has expired, update your card here"
